raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "A shared `phoneSchema` strips spaces, dashes, dots and parentheses before applying the original regex, and both the book and waitlist routes use it. So `+7 (701) 555-12-34` becomes `+77015551234` and is stored as the same client as the plain form, while `call me` and `+7 701` are still rejected. The one thing I couldn't check is whether the wizard also validates the phone client-side, since only the server routes are in the diff."}
